title: Tunisian Lamb Kebabs with Xtra Sweet Chili Sauce
description: A fusion of Chinese flavors with the bold spices of Tunisia. Grilled lamb kebabs served with a sweet and sour chili sauce.

ingredients.name: Tagine
ingredients.notes: red bell peppers, cut into large pieces

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sour, Tunisian, and xtra to make the sweet chili sauce. Set aside.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, grill the red bell peppers until slightly charred.
Serve the lamb kebabs with grilled red bell peppers and a drizzle of the sweet chili sauce.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
